title: Hybrid KV-tiling batching advisor with staged rollout & rollback playbook
creator: Nora Patel
description: Design and implement a Hybrid KV-tiling Batching Advisor that produces per-workload batching and caching recommendations, synthesizes continuous batching parameters, and provides a staged rollout + automated rollback playbook. The advisor combines workload profiling (temporal request patterns, sequence length distribution, KV reuse), heuristics for safe parameter candidates, and a continuous tuning loop that applies changes in shadow/canary modes before gradual traffic ramps. Emphasis on minimizing token cost while preserving latency SLOs and output quality for production workloads.
acceptance_criteria: Advisor produces per-workload candidate configurations: microbatch_size, max_batch_delay_ms, kv_window_ms, kv_shard_hint
Profiling pipeline runs nightly and stores signatures for each workload (latency distribution, token mix, kv-hit-rate estimates)
Staged rollout plan implemented: shadow validation -> 5% canary -> 25% ramp -> 100% apply with automated health gates

Rollback triggers defined and automated: latency increase > 15th percentile by 20% for 3 consecutive minutes, 99th percentile tail spike > threshold, cost per token increases > 8% without quality improvement
Integration tests cover safe-apply flow and rollback simulation using traffic replay harness
Dashboard panels exist for advisor suggestions, active experiments, and health metrics during rollout
design_decisions: Use a lightweight signature vector (25 dims) to represent workload; keep on-disk format compact for nightly aggregation
Hybrid approach: heuristics shortlist candidates and a small reinforcement-style tuner (bandit) explores near-optimal parameters under safety constraints
Prefer shadow apply with sampled requests for quality/regression checks before any live traffic ramp
KV-tiling heuristic prioritizes contiguous prefix reuse windows; we expose kv_window_ms and kv_shard_hint to runtime for compatibility
Keep rollback policy conservative: automated rollback only after continuous anomaly confirmation; manual override allowed for on-call
implementation_steps: Extend profiler service to emit kv-reuse estimates and microburst frequency per workload
Add candidate generator module that creates prioritized config proposals using cost/latency heuristics
Implement shadow validation path that runs proposed config in shadow and collects latency, kv-hit, and output-quality deltas
Build rollout controller capable of traffic slicing, ramping percentages, and gating based on metric windows
Add automated rollback engine with hysteresis to prevent flip-flop and an incident-mode manual hold
Wire advisor UI in Console: suggestion list, preview of estimated savings, and one-click staged apply
Add telemetry queries and Playbook docs for SRE on-call in case of regression
risks: Overaggressive batching can increase tail latency for bursty low-latency workloads
KV window misconfiguration could increase memory pressure on certain runtime topologies
Shadow validation might not fully capture production corner cases (geo/region differences)
Automated rollback false positives could block beneficial optimizations if thresholds are poorly tuned
rollout_plan: 1) Shadow validation: run candidate config on 1-2% sampled requests for 24 hours; collect metrics
2) Canary: apply to 5% of traffic for 30 minutes; gate on p95 latency, error rate, and quality score
3) Gradual ramp: 5% -> 25% -> 50% over hours with automated checks every 10 minutes
4) Full apply: if all gates pass for 2 hours, promote to 100% with monitoring spikes enabled
5) Observability: open a rollout trace with links to telemetry dashboards and cost delta projections
rollback_plan: Automated triggers (any of): p95 latency increase > 20% sustained for 5 minutes; error-rate increase > 0.5% absolute; quality regression score degradation > 3% on holdout prompts; cost increase > 12% without quality gain
Hysteresis: require trigger to be present across two consecutive evaluation windows (5m each) before automated rollback
Rollback action: revert to previous active config and mark candidate as blocked for 24h for the workload
Post-rollback: capture causal telemetry, create incident ticket using templated diagnosis checklist
Manual override: SRE/owner can hold rollout state or force rollback after human review
